title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 75 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 75)

content.overview: Former section 75 — Confidentiality belonged to the detailed conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. That detailed regime was superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical and transition reference and must not be presented as current general conciliation law.

examples.title: Transition check

hypotheticals.question: Can former section 75 be used as the current general rule?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Treat it as historical/transition material and determine whether section 62 saves the proceeding; otherwise apply the Mediation Act, 2023.
